labelDefinition: useful = the call's concrete input or output would likely be used again while continuing the current task, even when duplicated elsewhere or recoverable; a partly edited file whose unchanged content is useful qualifies; genuinely superseded or irrelevant content does not. Primary = labelers A and B agree on true/false; otherwise unresolved (null).

labelers.a: independent blind annotator A, labels before any model response
labelers.b: independent blind annotator B, labels before any model response; partial reads of about 20 long outputs disclosed
